overview.description: The XFUNDS 1-3 Month BOX ETF (XCSH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF aiming to match or exceed the total return of 13 month US Treasury bills. Instead of direct ownership, the ETFs uses a combination of option positions, known as box spreads, seeking to replicate the economics of a short-term zero-coupon bond XCSH was launched on Aug 17, 2026 and is issued by XFUNDS.
